kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تضاءلت (form VI)
# تَضَاءَلْتُ (taḍāʔaltu) /ta.dˤaː.ʔal.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَضَاءَلَ (taḍāʔala)
# تَضَاءَلْتَ (taḍāʔalta) /ta.dˤaː.ʔal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَضَاءَلَ (taḍāʔala)
# تَضَاءَلْتِ (taḍāʔalti) /ta.dˤaː.ʔal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَضَاءَلَ (taḍāʔala)
# تَضَاءَلَتْ (taḍāʔalat) /ta.dˤaː.ʔa.lat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
